title: BA1/1590/2012 of RAHUL TYAGI @ SACHIN SHARMA Vs STATE OF UTTRAKHAND

paras.text:
1
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Original Jurisdiction
Dated: Nainital: the 11th day of December, 2012
First Bail Application No. 1590 of 2012
Criminal Side
Rahul Tyagi @ Sachin Sharma
S/o Shri Mangu Singh Tyagi
R/o Village Khadkhadi
P.S. Hapur Dehat, District Hapur
presently residing at 730, G.F-4
Nitikhand-Ist, Indrapuram
Ghaziabad
 .......Applicant (In Jail)
Versus
State of Uttarakhand
 .....Opposite Party
Arising out of Case Crime/F.I.R No. 111 of 2012
Under Sections: 420 of I.P.C.
Police Station: Kotwali Gangnahar Roorkee
District: Hardwar
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Mr. S.K.Shandilya, Advocate, present for the
applicant.
Mr. K.S.RAngad, Brief Holder, present for the
State.
Heard.
2. Applicant- Rahul Tyagi @ Sachin Sharma, who

2
is in jail in connection with Case Crime No. 111 of
2012, relating to offence punishable under section 420
of I.P.C., Police Station Kotwali Gangnahar, District
Hardwar, has sought his release on bail.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that
co-accused Vinod Kumar Chaurasia, with similar role,
has already been directed to be released on bail. The
present applicant has no criminal history. It is pleaded
that there was no criminal intention on the part of the
applicant in asking the complainant and investors to
invest ` 11,000/- per head for attractive returns
promised on behalf of the Agrata Information
Technology Private Limited.
4. In the above circumstances, without expressing
any opinion as to final merits of the case, this Court is
of the view that applicant deserves bail.
5. Accordingly, the Bail Application is allowed. Let
applicant Rahul Tyagi @ Sachin Sharma be released
on bail on executing personal bond and furnishing two
sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of
Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee.
(Prafulla C. Pant, J.)
